levels.description:
Stops attacking, consuming 1 bullet every <@ba.vup>{attack@aim_interval}</>s to lock onto enemies in succession; when the skill ends, bombards the positions of all locked-on enemies, dealing <@ba.vup>{attack@proj_atk_scale_2:0%}</> of ATK as AoE Physical damage per bombardment (damage increases to <@ba.vup>{attack@proj_atk_scale_1:0%}</> of ATK for enemies in the center of the bombardment)
<@ba.rem>Skill activation grants {attack@trigger_time} ammo and the skill ends when all ammo is used (Can manually deactivate skill)</>
